# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are provided for the following versions:

| Version        | Supported |
| -------------- | --------- |
| Latest release | Yes       |
| Older releases | No        |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it
privately rather than creating a public GitHub issue or submit
it to my email: [nasserkarix@gmail.com](nasserkarix@gmail.com).
